alcohol_population.long_name: Total population of the area reported alongside the alcohol-related health harms snapshot
alcohol_population.short_description: Total population of the geography as reported alongside the alcohol-related EMS outcome.
alcohol_population.long_description: Total population denominator reported for a given county, state, or national area alongside the alcohol-related health harms snapshot. Provided for context, not as an independent outcome measure. Time period represented: 01/01/2022 – 07/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-07-31).

alcohol_ems_rate_low.long_name: Lower bound of the rate of EMS patient encounters for alcohol-related emergencies per 100,000 population
alcohol_ems_rate_low.short_description: Lower bound of the alcohol-related EMS encounter rate range for this county.
alcohol_ems_rate_low.long_description: Alcohol-related EMS encounter rates are reported only as a range, never as a single point value. This is the numeric lower bound of that range. Use alongside alcohol_ems_rate_high and alcohol_ems_rate_label -- do not average low/high into a point estimate. Time period represented: 01/01/2022 – 07/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-07-31).
alcohol_ems_rate_low.statement: In {location}, the alcohol-related EMS encounter rate fell between {value} and {alcohol_ems_rate_high} per 100,000 population.

alcohol_ems_rate_high.long_name: Upper bound of the rate of EMS patient encounters for alcohol-related emergencies per 100,000 population
alcohol_ems_rate_high.short_description: Upper bound of the alcohol-related EMS encounter rate range for this county.
alcohol_ems_rate_high.long_description: Numeric upper bound of the same range described in alcohol_ems_rate_low. See that field's description for the range estimate caveat. Time period represented: 01/01/2022 – 07/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-07-31).
alcohol_ems_rate_high.statement: In {location}, the alcohol-related EMS encounter rate fell between {alcohol_ems_rate_low} and {value} per 100,000 population.

alcohol_ems_rate_label.long_name: Qualitative label for the alcohol-related EMS encounter rate ramge, relative to the national average
alcohol_ems_rate_label.short_description: Text label describing this county's alcohol-related EMS encounter rate relative to the national average.
alcohol_ems_rate_label.long_description: A qualitative classification of the alcohol-related EMS rate, ranging from "Low Outlier" through "High Outlier", or "No Data" where the area had no reportable rate. Time period represented: 01/01/2022 – 07/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-07-31).
alcohol_ems_rate_label.statement: In {location}, the alcohol-related EMS rate was classified as "{value}".

ascvd_risk_low.long_name: Lower bound of the aggregate of 10-year risk of heart attack and stroke for people aged 40-70

Time period represented: 01/01/2022 – 07/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-07-31).
ascvd_risk_low.statement: In {location}, aggregate 10-year ASCVD risk fell between {value}% and {ascvd_risk_high}%.

ascvd_risk_high.long_name: Upper bound of the aggregate 10-year risk of heart attack and stroke for people aged 40-70
ascvd_risk_high.short_description: Upper bound (percent) of the ASCVD risk range for this area.

ascvd_risk_high.statement: In {location}, aggregate 10-year ASCVD risk fell between {ascvd_risk_low}% and {value}%.

maternal_population.long_name: Total population of the area reported alongside the maternal health snapshot
maternal_population.short_description: Total population of the geography as reported alongside the SOC rate outcome.
maternal_population.long_description: Total population denominator reported for a given ZCTA3, state, or national area alongside the maternal health snapshot. Provided for context, not as an independent outcome measure. Time period represented: 01/01/2021 – 05/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-05-31).

maternal_soc_rate_low.long_name: Lower bound of the rate of severe obstetric complications (SOC) per 10,000 deliveries
maternal_soc_rate_low.short_description: Lower bound of the SOC rate range for this area.
maternal_soc_rate_low.long_description: SOC rate (rate of severe obstetric complications during the delivery hospitalization and 60 days postpartum per 10,000 deliveries, open claims only) is reported only as a range (e.g. "192.3 to 243.9"), never as a single point value. This is the numeric lower bound of that range. Use alongside maternal_soc_rate_high and maternal_soc_rate_label -- do not average low/high into a point estimate, since the true value's position within the range is unknown. Time period represented: 01/01/2021 – 05/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-05-31).
maternal_soc_rate_low.statement: In {location}, the SOC rate fell between {value} and {maternal_soc_rate_high} per 10,000 deliveries.

maternal_soc_rate_high.long_name: Upper bound of the rate of severe obstetric complications (SOC) per 10,000 deliveries
maternal_soc_rate_high.short_description: Upper bound of the SOC rate range for this area.
maternal_soc_rate_high.long_description: Numeric upper bound of the same range described in maternal_soc_rate_low. See that field's description for the range-vs-point-estimate caveat. Time period represented: 01/01/2021 – 05/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-05-31).
maternal_soc_rate_high.statement: In {location}, the SOC rate fell between {maternal_soc_rate_low} and {value} per 10,000 deliveries.

maternal_soc_rate_label.long_name: Qualitative label for the severe obstetric complications (SOC) rate, relative to the national average
maternal_soc_rate_label.short_description: Text label describing this area's SOC rate relative to the national average (e.g. "Slightly Lower than National Average").
maternal_soc_rate_label.long_description: A qualitative classification of the SOC rate range, ranging from "Low Outlier" through "High Outlier", or "No Data" where the area had no reportable rate. Time period represented: 01/01/2021 – 05/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-05-31).
maternal_soc_rate_label.statement: In {location}, the SOC rate was classified as "{value}".
